summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, plus test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement (notably ~EX.p on a bare URIRef in tests) and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed.
